description: Desk picks that left the Queue because their edge is gone (expiredWhy "edge") or because their Grade came back D or F (expiredWhy "grade"), shown until their game starts (GET desk/expired): the same pick fields as get_desk (link, linkKind, linkNeedsState, linkMarket included) plus expired: true and expiredAt. An expired pick is no longer a pick at that price. Pro and up; Free and Starter get locked rows. Reads only.
